items.title: CARR Q3 deep dive: margin pressures and robust backlog reshape outlook
items.summary: Heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration company Carrier Global (NYSE:CARR) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 12.3% year on year to $6.26 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $23.9 billion at the midpoint came in 2.4% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.87 per share was 13.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
